newsitem.title: USA: Staples says store sale contingent on FTC.
newsitem.headline: Staples says store sale contingent on FTC.

text.p: Staples Inc on Friday said its agreement to sell 63 business-supply superstores to OfficeMax Inc was contingent on the Federal Trade Commission's approval of its proposed merger with Office Depot Inc.

OfficeMax agreed in March to acquire 28 Office Depot and 35 Staples stores for $109 million once the two companies merged. The deal was an attempt by Staples to ease FTC conerns over the proposed $4 billion stock merger, but the commission voted to reject their planned union earlier Friday.
"The deal to Officemax is contingent on the FTC...letting our deal proceed," Staples spokesman Todd Krasnow told Reuters.
Krasnow said company officials had not yet read the FTC decision and needed to evaluate all options available.
